cues.text: Frame 0, the cover: a laptop on an office desk playing a sales demo, a robot in a headset with a speech balloon full of ringing phones. The title plate up top, settled: "The demo says you need" / "an AI receptionist." Snow in his spot.
Cut by 0.8 s: close on the robot in the headset; three phones ring around it and each gets a green check.
Cut: the demo poster, and a red rubber stamp lands: "MYTH?". The plate stays.
The calendar set: this month. On "pay" a coin lands on day 1.
A run of green checks fills the first two weeks. Line under the grid: "Calls: answered."
Red x's run through the days after. Line: "Quotes: no follow-up."
Our own outbox tray. "Fix follow-up first." slams in; the prompt card (AI chat app, example) waits.
Prompt line 1 types on as said.
Line 2. The drafted check-in drops into the tray (example), a padlock on it: HELD FOR YOU.
An eye blinks over the draft on "read"; on "send" the big green key presses, the lock opens, the envelope flies out. The prompt stays up 3 s or more.
The high-score cabinet: "TRUST IN AI TOOLS". On screen: "ServiceTitan survey" / "1,000+ residential service contractors, 2026".
Row 1 slides in: "HIGH OR COMPLETE 11%", gold.
The boss arena: THE MYTH. The moves menu: "You hit send", "Follow-up first". On "hand" the first move hits.
The second move hits on "Fix"; on "buy" the myth breaks into pixels and "BUSTED!" stamps in. [sfx: sting]
"Follow-up first." lands under it, gold. Then the end card with the send line: "Send this to whoever handles your follow-ups."
